name: Context Optimization
purpose: Reduce token consumption of already-loaded context without losing task-critical information through deduplication, relevance pruning, lossless summarization of verbose payloads, and cache-directive annotations.
inputs: Loaded working set with measured per-section token cost and target budget
Acceptance criteria defining which facts are critical and must survive verbatim
Redundancy profile and cache topology for prompt-caching annotations
outputs: Optimized working set within target budget with critical facts intact
Token accounting sheet with per-section savings
Cache annotations for stable prefix blocks
stop_conditions: Working set fits the target budget with all critical facts verbatim
Further compression would touch critical facts; larger budget requested instead
